        "contents": "    async fn emit_review_started(\n        &amp;self,\n        request_id: &amp;RequestId,\n        turn: Turn,\n        parent_thread_id: String,\n        review_thread_id: String,\n    ) {\n        let response = ReviewStartResponse {\n            turn: turn.clone(),\n            review_thread_id,\n        };\n        self.outgoing\n            .send_response(request_id.clone(), response)\n            .await;\n\n        let notif = TurnStartedNotification {\n            thread_id: parent_thread_id,\n            turn,\n        };\n        self.outgoing\n            .send_server_notification(ServerNotification::TurnStarted(notif))\n            .await;\n    }\n\n    async fn start_inline_review(\n        &amp;self,\n        request_id: &amp;RequestId,\n        parent_conversation: Arc&lt;CodexConversation&gt;,\n        review_request: ReviewRequest,\n        display_text: &amp;str,\n        parent_thread_id: String,\n    ) -&gt; std::result::Result&lt;(), JSONRPCErrorError&gt; {\n        let turn_id = parent_conversation\n            .submit(Op::Review { review_request })\n            .await;\n\n        match turn_id {\n            Ok(turn_id) =&gt; {\n                let turn = Self::build_review_turn(turn_id, display_text);\n                self.emit_review_started(\n                    request_id,\n                    turn,\n                    parent_thread_id.clone(),\n                    parent_thread_id,\n                )\n                .await;\n                Ok(())\n            }\n            Err(err) =&gt; Err(JSONRPCErrorError {\n                code: INTERNAL_ERROR_CODE,\n                message: format!(\"failed to start review: {err}\"),\n                data: None,\n            }),\n        }\n    }\n\n    async fn start_detached_review(\n        &amp;mut self,\n        request_id: &amp;RequestId",

        "contents": "    async fn skills_list(&amp;self, request_id: RequestId, params: SkillsListParams) {\n        let SkillsListParams { cwds, force_reload } = params;\n        let cwds = if cwds.is_empty() {\n            vec![self.config.cwd.clone()]\n        } else {\n            cwds\n        };\n\n        let skills_manager = self.conversation_manager.skills_manager();\n        let data = cwds\n            .into_iter()\n            .map(|cwd| {\n                let outcome = skills_manager.skills_for_cwd_with_options(&amp;cwd, force_reload);\n                let errors = errors_to_info(&amp;outcome.errors);\n                let skills = skills_to_info(&amp;outcome.skills);\n                codex_app_server_protocol::SkillsListEntry {\n                    cwd,\n                    skills,\n                    errors,\n                }\n            })\n            .collect();\n        self.outgoing\n            .send_response(request_id, SkillsListResponse { data })\n            .await;\n    }\n\n    async fn interrupt_conversation(\n        &amp;mut self,\n        request_id: RequestId",

        "contents": "    async fn emit_review_started(\n        &amp;self,\n        request_id: &amp;RequestId,\n        turn: Turn,\n        parent_thread_id: String,\n        review_thread_id: String,\n    ) {\n        let response = ReviewStartResponse {\n            turn: turn.clone(),\n            review_thread_id,\n        };\n        self.outgoing\n            .send_response(request_id.clone(), response)\n            .await;\n\n        let notif = TurnStartedNotification {\n            thread_id: parent_thread_id,\n            turn,\n        };\n        self.outgoing\n            .send_server_notification(ServerNotification::TurnStarted(notif))\n            .await;\n    }\n\n    async fn start_inline_review(\n        &amp;self,\n        request_id: &amp;RequestId,\n        parent_conversation: Arc&lt;CodexConversation&gt;,\n        review_request: ReviewRequest,\n        display_text: &amp;str,\n        parent_thread_id: String,\n    ) -&gt; std::result::Result&lt;(), JSONRPCErrorError&gt; {\n        let turn_id = parent_conversation\n            .submit(Op::Review { review_request })\n            .await;\n\n        match turn_id {\n            Ok(turn_id) =&gt; {\n                let turn = Self::build_review_turn(turn_id, display_text);\n                self.emit_review_started(\n                    request_id,\n                    turn,\n                    parent_thread_id.clone(),\n                    parent_thread_id,\n                )\n                .await;\n                Ok(())\n            }\n            Err(err) =&gt; Err(JSONRPCErrorError {\n                code: INTERNAL_ERROR_CODE,\n                message: format!(\"failed to start review: {err}\"),\n                data: None,\n            }),\n        }\n    }\n\n    async fn start_detached_review(\n        &amp;mut self,\n        request_id: &amp;RequestId",

        "contents": "    async fn send_user_message(&amp;self, request_id: RequestId, params: SendUserMessageParams) {\n        let SendUserMessageParams {\n            conversation_id,\n            items,\n        } = params;\n        let Ok(conversation) = self\n            .conversation_manager\n            .get_conversation(conversation_id)\n            .await\n        else {\n            let error = JSONRPCErrorError {\n                code: INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR_CODE,\n                message: format!(\"conversation not found: {conversation_id}\"),\n                data: None,\n            };\n            self.outgoing.send_error(request_id, error).await;\n            return;\n        };\n\n        let mapped_items: Vec&lt;CoreInputItem&gt; = items\n            .into_iter()\n            .map(|item| match item {\n                WireInputItem::Text { text } =&gt; CoreInputItem::Text { text },\n                WireInputItem::Image { image_url } =&gt; CoreInputItem::Image { image_url },\n                WireInputItem::LocalImage { path } =&gt; CoreInputItem::LocalImage { path },\n            })\n            .collect();\n\n        // Submit user input to the conversation.\n        let _ = conversation\n            .submit(Op::UserInput {\n                items: mapped_items,\n            })\n            .await;\n\n        // Acknowledge with an empty result.\n        self.outgoing\n            .send_response(request_id, SendUserMessageResponse {})\n            .await;\n    }\n\n    async fn send_user_turn",

        "contents": "            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    async fn fuzzy_file_search(&amp;mut self, request_id: RequestId, params: FuzzyFileSearchParams) {\n        let FuzzyFileSearchParams {\n            query,\n            roots,\n            cancellation_token,\n        } = params;\n\n        let cancel_flag = match cancellation_token.clone() {\n            Some(token) =&gt; {\n                let mut pending_fuzzy_searches = self.pending_fuzzy_searches.lock().await;\n                // if a cancellation_token is provided and a pending_request exists for\n                // that token, cancel it\n                if let Some(existing) = pending_fuzzy_searches.get(&amp;token) {\n                    existing.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);\n                }\n                let flag = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));\n                pending_fuzzy_searches.insert(token.clone(), flag.clone());\n                flag\n            }\n            None =&gt; Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false)),\n        };\n\n        let results = match query.as_str() {\n            \"\" =&gt; vec![],\n            _ =&gt; run_fuzzy_file_search(query, roots, cancel_flag.clone()).await,\n        };\n\n        if let Some(token) = cancellation_token {\n            let mut pending_fuzzy_searches = self.pending_fuzzy_searches.lock().await;\n            if let Some(current_flag) = pending_fuzzy_searches.get(&amp;token)\n                &amp;&amp; Arc::ptr_eq(current_flag, &amp;cancel_flag)\n            {\n                pending_fuzzy_searches.remove(&amp;token);\n            }\n        }\n\n        let response = FuzzyFileSearchResponse { files: results };\n        self.outgoing.send_response(request_id, response).await;\n    }\n\n    async fn upload_feedback(&amp;self, request_id: RequestId,",

All relative paths provided by\n    /// the model as well as sandbox policies are resolved against this path\n    /// instead of &#96;std::env::current_dir()&#96;.\n    pub(crate) cwd: PathBuf,\n    pub(crate) developer_instructions: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub(crate) base_instructions: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub(crate) compact_prompt: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub(crate) user_instructions: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub(crate) approval_policy: AskForApproval,\n    pub(crate) sandbox_policy: SandboxPolicy,\n    pub(crate) shell_environment_policy: ShellEnvironmentPolicy,\n    pub(crate) tools_config: ToolsConfig,\n    pub(crate) ghost_snapshot: GhostSnapshotConfig,\n    pub(crate) final_output_json_schema: Option&lt;Value&gt;,\n    pub(crate) codex_linux_sandbox_exe: Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;,\n    pub(crate) tool_call_gate: Arc&lt;ReadinessFlag&gt;,\n    pub(crate) exec_policy: Arc&lt;RwLock&lt;ExecPolicy&gt;&gt;,\n    pub(crate) truncation_policy: TruncationPolicy,\n}\n\nimpl TurnContext {\n    pub(crate) fn resolve_path(&amp;self, path: Option&lt;String&gt;) -&gt; PathBuf {\n        path.as_ref()\n            .map(PathBuf::from)\n            .map_or_else(|| self.cwd.clone(), |p| self.cwd.join(p))\n    }\n\n    pub(crate) fn compact_prompt(&amp;self) -&gt; &amp;str {\n        self.compact_prompt\n            .as_deref()\n            .unwrap_or(compact::SUMMARIZATION_PROMPT)\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub(crate) struct SessionConfiguration {\n    /// Provider identifier (\"openai\", \"openrouter\", ...).",

        "contents": "    pub(super) async fn open_session_with_sandbox(\n        &amp;self,\n        command: &amp;[String],\n        cwd: PathBuf,\n        sandbox_permissions: SandboxPermissions,\n        justification: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n        context: &amp;UnifiedExecContext,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;UnifiedExecSession, UnifiedExecError&gt; {\n        let env = apply_unified_exec_env(create_env(&amp;context.turn.shell_environment_policy));\n        let features = context.session.features();\n        let mut orchestrator = ToolOrchestrator::new();\n        let mut runtime = UnifiedExecRuntime::new(self);\n        let exec_approval_requirement = create_exec_approval_requirement_for_command(\n            &amp;context.turn.exec_policy,\n            &amp;features,\n            command,\n            context.turn.approval_policy,\n            &amp;context.turn.sandbox_policy,\n            sandbox_permissions,\n        )\n        .await;\n        let req = UnifiedExecToolRequest::new(\n            command.to_vec(),\n            cwd,\n            env,\n            sandbox_permissions,\n            justification,\n            exec_approval_requirement,\n        );\n        let tool_ctx = ToolCtx {\n            session: context.session.as_ref(),\n            turn: context.turn.as_ref(),\n            call_id: context.call_id.clone(),\n            tool_name: \"exec_command\".to_string(),\n        };\n        orchestrator\n            .run(\n                &amp;mut runtime,\n                &amp;req,\n                &amp;tool_ctx,\n                context.turn.as_ref(),\n                context.turn.approval_policy,\n            )\n            .await\n            .map_err(|e| UnifiedExecError::create_session(format!(\"{e:?}\")))\n    }\n\n    pub(super) async fn collect_output_until_deadline",

        "contents": "        store.remove(process_id);\n    }\n\n    pub(crate) async fn exec_command(\n        &amp;self,\n        request: ExecCommandRequest,\n        context: &amp;UnifiedExecContext,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;UnifiedExecResponse, UnifiedExecError&gt; {\n        let cwd = request\n            .workdir\n            .clone()\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| context.turn.cwd.clone());\n\n        let session = self\n            .open_session_with_sandbox(\n                &amp;request.command,\n                cwd.clone(),\n                request.sandbox_permissions,\n                request.justification,\n                context,\n            )\n            .await;\n\n        let session = match session {\n            Ok(session) =&gt; Arc::new(session),\n            Err(err) =&gt; {\n                self.release_process_id(&amp;request.process_id).await;\n                return Err(err);\n            }\n        };\n\n        let transcript = Arc::new(tokio::sync::Mutex::new(CommandTranscript::default()));\n        start_streaming_output(&amp;session, context, Arc::clone(&amp;transcript));\n\n        let max_tokens = resolve_max_tokens(request.max_output_tokens);\n        let yield_time_ms = clamp_yield_time(request.yield_time_ms);\n\n        let start = Instant::now();\n        // For the initial exec_command call, we both stream output to events\n        // (via start_streaming_output above) and collect a snapshot here for\n        // the tool response body.\n        let OutputHandles {\n            output_buffer,\n            output_notify,\n            cancellation_token,\n        } = session.output_handles();\n        let deadline = start + Duration::from_millis(yield_time_ms);\n        let collected = Self::collect_output_until_deadline(\n            &amp;output_buffer,\n            &amp;output_notify,\n            &amp;cancellation_token,\n            deadline,\n        )\n        .await;\n        let wall_time = Instant::now().saturating_duration_since(start);\n\n        let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;collected).to_string();\n        let output = formatted_truncate_text(&amp;text, TruncationPolicy::Tokens(max_tokens));\n        let exit_code = session.exit_code();",

        "contents": "//! Parallel AI execution orchestration\n//!\n//! Executes multiple AI agents (Codex, GeminiCLI, Claudecode) in parallel\n//! for competition-style development with worktree isolation.\n\nuse anyhow::Context;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::process::Stdio;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse tokio::process::Command;\nuse tokio::sync::RwLock;\nuse tokio::task::JoinHandle;\nuse uuid::Uuid;\n\nuse super::resource_manager::ResourceGuard;\nuse super::resource_manager::ResourceManager;\nuse super::worktree_manager::WorktreeInfo;\nuse super::worktree_manager::WorktreeManager;\nuse codex_protocol::config_types::ReasoningSummary;\nuse codex_protocol::config_types::Verbosity;\nuse codex_protocol::openai_models::ReasoningEffort;\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]\n#[serde(rename_all = \"lowercase\")]\npub enum AgentType {\n    Codex,\n    GeminiCLI,\n    Claudecode,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct ReasoningConfig {\n    pub effort: ReasoningEffort,\n    pub summary: ReasoningSummary,\n    pub verbosity: Verbosity,\n}\n\nimpl Default for ReasoningConfig {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            effort: ReasoningEffort::default(),\n            summary: ReasoningSummary::default(),\n            verbosity: Verbosity::default(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct AgentTask {\n    pub agent: AgentType,\n    pub prompt: String,\n    pub worktree_path: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub timeout_seconds: Option&lt;u64&gt;,\n    pub reasoning_effort: Option&lt;ReasoningEffort&gt;,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct AgentResult {\n    pub agent: AgentType,\n    pub success: bool,\n    pub output: String,\n    pub elapsed_seconds: f64,\n    pub error: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub enum AgentStatus {\n    Pending,\n    Running,\n    Completed,\n    Failed,\n    Timeout,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]",

&amp;'static str {\n        self.info().key\n    }\n\n    pub fn stage(self) -&gt; Stage {\n        self.info().stage\n    }\n\n    pub fn default_enabled(self) -&gt; bool {\n        self.info().default_enabled\n    }\n\n    fn info(self) -&gt;         "contents": " Vec&lt;(String, serde_json::Value)&gt; {\n        let mut tool_calls = Vec::new();\n\n        // パターン: TOOL_CALL: tool_name(arg1=\"value1\", arg2=\"value2\")\n        // 簡易実装: JSONフォーマットも検出\n        for line in response.lines() {\n            let line = line.trim();\n\n            // TOOL_CALL: codex_read_file(path=\"src/auth.rs\")\n            if line.starts_with(\"TOOL_CALL:\")\n                &amp;&amp; let Some(call_str) = line.strip_prefix(\"TOOL_CALL:\").map(str::trim)\n                &amp;&amp; let Some((tool_name, args_str)) = call_str.split_once('(')\n            {\n                let tool_name = tool_name.trim().to_string();\n                let args_str = args_str.trim_end_matches(')').trim();\n\n                // 簡易パース: key=\"value\" 形式\n                let mut args = serde_json::Map::new();\n                for part in args_str.split(',') {\n                    if let Some((key, value)) = part.split_once('=') {\n                        let key = key.trim().to_string();\n                        let value = value.trim().trim_matches('\"').to_string();\n                        args.insert(key, serde_json::Value::String(value));\n                    }\n                }\n\n                tool_calls.push((tool_name, serde_json::Value::Object(args)));\n            }\n        }\n\n        tool_calls\n    }\n\n    /// Codex MCPツールを実行\n    async fn execute_codex_mcp_tool(\n        &amp;self,\n        mcp_client: &amp;Arc&lt;RmcpClient&gt;",

        "contents": "impl ToolsConfig {\n    pub fn new(params: &amp;ToolsConfigParams) -&gt; Self {\n        let ToolsConfigParams {\n            model_family,\n            features,\n        } = params;\n        let include_apply_patch_tool = features.enabled(Feature::ApplyPatchFreeform);\n        let include_web_search_request = features.enabled(Feature::WebSearchRequest);\n        let include_view_image_tool = features.enabled(Feature::ViewImageTool);\n\n        let shell_type = if !features.enabled(Feature::ShellTool) {\n            ConfigShellToolType::Disabled\n        } else if features.enabled(Feature::UnifiedExec) {\n            // If ConPTY not supported (for old Windows versions), fallback on ShellCommand.\n            if codex_utils_pty::conpty_supported() {\n                ConfigShellToolType::UnifiedExec\n            } else {\n                ConfigShellToolType::ShellCommand\n            }\n        } else {\n            model_family.shell_type\n        };\n\n        let apply_patch_tool_type = match model_family.apply_patch_tool_type {\n            Some(ApplyPatchToolType::Freeform) =&gt; Some(ApplyPatchToolType::Freeform),\n            Some(ApplyPatchToolType::Function) =&gt; Some(ApplyPatchToolType::Function),\n            None =&gt; {\n                if include_apply_patch_tool {\n                    Some(ApplyPatchToolType::Freeform)\n                } else {\n                    None\n                }\n            }\n        };\n\n        Self {\n            shell_type,\n            apply_patch_tool_type,\n            web_search_request: include_web_search_request,\n            include_view_image_tool,\n            experimental_supported_tools: model_family.experimental_supported_tools.clone(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Generic JSON‑Schema subset needed for our tool definitions\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]\n#[serde(tag = \"type\", rename_all = \"lowercase\")]\npub(crate) enum JsonSchema {\n    Boolean",

pub fn create_apply_patch_sse_response(
    patch_content: &str,
    call_id: &str,
) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
    // Use shell command to call apply_patch with heredoc format
    let shell_command = format!("apply_patch <<'EOF'\n{patch_content}\nEOF");
    let tool_call_arguments = serde_json::to_string(&json!({
        "command": ["bash", "-lc", shell_command]
    }))?;

    let tool_call = json!({
        "choices": [
            {
                "delta": {
                    "tool_calls": [
                        {
                            "id": call_id,
                            "function": {
                                "name": "shell",
                                "arguments": tool_call_arguments
                            }
                        }
                    ]
                },
                "finish_reason": "tool_calls"
            }
        ]
    });

    let sse = format!(
        "data: {}\n\ndata: DONE\n\n",
        serde_json::to_string(&tool_call)?
    );
    Ok(sse)
}

// Alias for create_shell_sse_response
pub fn create_shell_command_sse_response(
    command: Vec<String>,
    workdir: Option<&Path>,
    timeout_ms: Option<u64>,
    call_id: &str,
) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
    create_shell_sse_response(command, workdir, timeout_ms, call_id)
}

// Create SSE response for exec_command (unified_exec tool)
pub fn create_exec_command_sse_response(
    command: Vec<String>,
    workdir: Option<&Path>,
    timeout_ms: Option<u64>,
    call_id: &str,
) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
    // unified_exec tool uses the same format as shell
    let tool_call_arguments = serde_json::to_string(&json!({
        "command": command,
        "workdir": workdir.map(|w| w.to_string_lossy()),
        "timeout": timeout_ms
    }))?;
    let tool_call = json!({
        "choices": [
            {
                "delta": {
                    "tool_calls": [
                        {
                            "id": call_id,
                            "function": {
                                "name": "unified_exec",
                                "arguments": tool_call_arguments
                            }
                        }
                    ]
                },
                "finish_reason": "tool_calls"
            }
        ]
    });

    let sse = format!(
        "data: {}\n\ndata: DONE\n\n",
        serde_json::to_string(&tool_call)?
    );
    Ok(sse)
}

        "contents": " Vec&lt;(String, serde_json::Value)&gt; {\n        let mut tool_calls = Vec::new();\n\n        // パターン: TOOL_CALL: tool_name(arg1=\"value1\", arg2=\"value2\")\n        // 簡易実装: JSONフォーマットも検出\n        for line in response.lines() {\n            let line = line.trim();\n\n            // TOOL_CALL: codex_read_file(path=\"src/auth.rs\")\n            if line.starts_with(\"TOOL_CALL:\")\n                &amp;&amp; let Some(call_str) = line.strip_prefix(\"TOOL_CALL:\").map(str::trim)\n                &amp;&amp; let Some((tool_name, args_str)) = call_str.split_once('(')\n            {\n                let tool_name = tool_name.trim().to_string();\n                let args_str = args_str.trim_end_matches(')').trim();\n\n                // 簡易パース: key=\"value\" 形式\n                let mut args = serde_json::Map::new();\n                for part in args_str.split(',') {\n                    if let Some((key, value)) = part.split_once('=') {\n                        let key = key.trim().to_string();\n                        let value = value.trim().trim_matches('\"').to_string();\n                        args.insert(key, serde_json::Value::String(value));\n                    }\n                }\n\n                tool_calls.push((tool_name, serde_json::Value::Object(args)));\n            }\n        }\n\n        tool_calls\n    }\n\n    /// Codex MCPツールを実行\n    async fn execute_codex_mcp_tool(\n        &amp;self,\n        mcp_client: &amp;Arc&lt;RmcpClient&gt;",

        "contents": "        store.remove(process_id);\n    }\n\n    pub(crate) async fn exec_command(\n        &amp;self,\n        request: ExecCommandRequest,\n        context: &amp;UnifiedExecContext,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;UnifiedExecResponse, UnifiedExecError&gt; {\n        let cwd = request\n            .workdir\n            .clone()\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| context.turn.cwd.clone());\n\n        let session = self\n            .open_session_with_sandbox(\n                &amp;request.command,\n                cwd.clone(),\n                request.sandbox_permissions,\n                request.justification,\n                context,\n            )\n            .await;\n\n        let session = match session {\n            Ok(session) =&gt; Arc::new(session),\n            Err(err) =&gt; {\n                self.release_process_id(&amp;request.process_id).await;\n                return Err(err);\n            }\n        };\n\n        let transcript = Arc::new(tokio::sync::Mutex::new(CommandTranscript::default()));\n        start_streaming_output(&amp;session, context, Arc::clone(&amp;transcript));\n\n        let max_tokens = resolve_max_tokens(request.max_output_tokens);\n        let yield_time_ms = clamp_yield_time(request.yield_time_ms);\n\n        let start = Instant::now();\n        // For the initial exec_command call, we both stream output to events\n        // (via start_streaming_output above) and collect a snapshot here for\n        // the tool response body.\n        let OutputHandles {\n            output_buffer,\n            output_notify,\n            cancellation_token,\n        } = session.output_handles();\n        let deadline = start + Duration::from_millis(yield_time_ms);\n        let collected = Self::collect_output_until_deadline(\n            &amp;output_buffer,\n            &amp;output_notify,\n            &amp;cancellation_token,\n            deadline,\n        )\n        .await;\n        let wall_time = Instant::now().saturating_duration_since(start);\n\n        let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;collected).to_string();\n        let output = formatted_truncate_text(&amp;text, TruncationPolicy::Tokens(max_tokens));\n        let exit_code = session.exit_code();",

        "contents": "            for (tool_name, tool_args) in tool_calls {\n                if !allowed_tools.contains(&amp;tool_name) {\n                    let error_msg =\n                        format!(\"ERROR: Tool '{tool_name}' is not permitted for this agent\");\n                    tool_results.push(error_msg);\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                info!(\n                    \"Executing Codex MCP tool: {} with args: {:?}\",\n                    tool_name, tool_args\n                );\n\n                match self\n                    .execute_codex_mcp_tool(&amp;mcp_client, &amp;tool_name, tool_args)\n                    .await\n                {\n                    Ok(result) =&gt; {\n                        tool_results.push(format!(\"TOOL_RESULT[{tool_name}]: {result}\"));\n                    }\n                    Err(e) =&gt; {\n                        let error_msg = format!(\"ERROR executing tool '{tool_name}': {e}\");\n                        error!(\"{error_msg}\");\n                        tool_results.push(error_msg);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            // ツール結果をLLMにフィードバック\n            let feedback = tool_results.join(\"\\n\\n\");\n            conversation_history.push((\"user\".to_string(), feedback.clone()));\n            artifacts.push(format!(\"--- Tool Execution Results ---\\n{feedback}\"));\n        }\n\n        info!(\"Agent '{}' completed execution\", agent_def.name);\n\n        Ok(artifacts)\n    }\n\n    /// LLMを呼び出してエージェントの応答を取得\n    async fn call_llm_for_agent(&amp;self, conversation: &amp;[(String, String)]) -&gt; Result&lt;String&gt; {\n        // プロンプト構築（最新のメッセージのみを使用）\n        let last_message = conversation\n            .last()\n            .",

        "contents": "        let output = formatted_truncate_text(&amp;text, TruncationPolicy::Tokens(max_tokens));\n        let original_token_count = approx_token_count(&amp;text);\n        let chunk_id = generate_chunk_id();\n\n        // After polling, refresh_session_state tells us whether the PTY is\n        // still alive or has exited and been removed from the store; we thread\n        // that through so the handler can tag TerminalInteraction with an\n        // appropriate process_id and exit_code.\n        let status = self.refresh_session_state(process_id.as_str()).await;\n        let (process_id, exit_code, event_call_id) = match status {\n            SessionStatus::Alive {\n                exit_code,\n                call_id,\n                process_id,\n            } =&gt; (Some(process_id), exit_code, call_id),\n            SessionStatus::Exited { exit_code, entry } =&gt; {\n                let call_id = entry.call_id.clone();\n                (None, exit_code, call_id)\n            }\n            SessionStatus::Unknown =&gt; {\n                return Err(UnifiedExecError::UnknownSessionId {\n                    process_id: request.process_id.to_string(),\n                });\n            }\n        };\n\n        let response = UnifiedExecResponse {\n            event_call_id,\n            chunk_id,\n            wall_time,\n            output,\n            raw_output: collected,\n            process_id,\n            exit_code,\n            original_token_count: Some(original_token_count),\n            session_command: Some(session_command.clone()),\n        };\n\n        if response.process_id.is_some() {\n            Self::emit_waiting_status(&amp;session_ref, &amp;turn_ref, &amp;session_command).await;\n        }\n\n        Ok(response)\n    }\n\n    async fn refresh_session_state",

Result&lt;UnifiedExecResponse, UnifiedExecError&gt; {\n        let process_id = request.process_id.to_string();\n\n        let PreparedSessionHandles {\n            writer_tx,\n            output_buffer,\n            output_notify,\n            cancellation_token,\n            session_ref,\n            turn_ref,\n            command: session_command,\n            process_id,\n            ..\n        } = self.prepare_session_handles(process_id.as_str()).await?;\n\n        if !request.input.is_empty() {\n            Self::send_input(&amp;writer_tx, request.input.as_bytes()).await?;\n            // Give the remote process a brief window to react so that we are\n            // more likely to capture its output in the poll below.\n            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;\n        }\n\n        let max_tokens = resolve_max_tokens(request.max_output_tokens);\n        let yield_time_ms = clamp_yield_time(request.yield_time_ms);\n        let start = Instant::now();\n        let deadline = start + Duration::from_millis(yield_time_ms);\n        let collected = Self::collect_output_until_deadline(\n            &amp;output_buffer,\n            &amp;output_notify,\n            &amp;cancellation_token,\n            deadline,\n        )\n        .await;\n        let wall_time = Instant::now().saturating_duration_since(start);\n\n        let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;collected).to_string();\n        let output = formatted_truncate_text(&amp;text, TruncationPolicy::Tokens(max_tokens));\n        let original_token_count = approx_token_count(&amp;text);",

        "contents": "        self.collaboration_store\n            .store_agent_result(agent_name.to_string(), result.clone());\n\n        Ok(result)\n    }\n\n    /// エージェントを実際に実行\n    async fn execute_agent(\n        &amp;self,\n        agent_def: &amp;AgentDefinition,\n        goal: &amp;str,\n        inputs: HashMap&lt;String, String&gt;,\n        _deadline: Option&lt;u64&gt;,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;String&gt;&gt; {\n        debug!(\"Executing agent '{}' with goal: {}\", agent_def.name, goal);\n\n        // 1. システムプロンプト構築（シンプル版）\n        let _system_prompt = format!(\"You are a {} agent. {}\", agent_def.name, agent_def.goal);\n\n        // 2. ユーザー入力を構築（タスクとinputsを含む）\n        let inputs_text = if inputs.is_empty() {\n            String::new()\n        } else {\n            let mut text = String::from(\"\\n\\nProvided inputs:\\n\");\n            for (key, value) in &amp;inputs {\n                text.push_str(&amp;format!(\"- {key}: {value}\\n\"));\n            }\n            text\n        };\n\n        let user_message = format!(\n            \"Task: {goal}{inputs_text}\\n\\nPlease analyze the task and provide a detailed response.\"\n        );\n\n        // 3. ModelClient作成\n        let model = self.config.model.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"gpt-5.2-codex\");\n        let model_family = crate::models_manager::model_family::find_family_for_model(model)\n            .with_config_overrides(&amp;self.config);\n        let client = ModelClient::new(\n            self.config.clone(),\n            self.auth_manager.clone(),\n            model_family,\n            self.otel_manager.clone(),\n            self.provider.clone(),\n            Some(ReasoningEffort::Medium),\n            ReasoningSummary::Detailed,\n            self.conversation_id,\n            codex_protocol::protocol::SessionSource::Cli, // zapabob: デフォルトはCLI\n        );\n\n        // 4. pub fn create_apply_patch_sse_response(
    patch_content: &str,
    call_id: &str,
) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
    // Use shell command to call apply_patch with heredoc format
    let shell_command = format!("apply_patch <<'EOF'\n{patch_content}\nEOF");
    let tool_call_arguments = serde_json::to_string(&json!({
        "command": ["bash", "-lc", shell_command]
    }))?;

    let tool_call = json!({
        "choices": [
            {
                "delta": {
                    "tool_calls": [
                        {
                            "id": call_id,
                            "function": {
                                "name": "shell",
                                "arguments": tool_call_arguments
                            }
                        }
                    ]
                },
                "finish_reason": "tool_calls"
            }
        ]
    });

    let sse = format!(
        "data: {}\n\ndata: DONE\n\n",
        serde_json::to_string(&tool_call)?
    );
    Ok(sse)
}

/// Alias for create_shell_sse_response for backward compatibility
pub fn create_shell_command_sse_response(
    command: Vec<String>,
    workdir: Option<&Path>,
    timeout_ms: Option<u64>,
    call_id: &str,
) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
    create_shell_sse_response(command, workdir, timeout_ms, call_id)
}

/// Create SSE response for exec_command tool (unified_exec)
pub fn create_exec_command_sse_response(
    command: Vec<String>,
    workdir: Option<&Path>,
    timeout_ms: Option<u64>,
    call_id: &str,
) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
    // The `arguments` for the `exec_command` tool is similar to shell but uses unified_exec
    let tool_call_arguments = serde_json::to_string(&json!({
        "command": command,
        "workdir": workdir.map(|w| w.to_string_lossy()),
        "timeout": timeout_ms
    }))?;
    let tool_call = json!({
        "choices": [
            {
                "delta": {
                    "tool_calls": [
                        {
                            "id": call_id,
                            "function": {
                                "name": "exec_command",
                                "arguments": tool_call_arguments
                            }
                        }
                    ]
                },
                "finish_reason": "tool_calls"
            }
        ]
    });

    let sse = format!(
        "data: {}\n\ndata: DONE\n\n",
        serde_json::to_string(&tool_call)?
    );
    Ok(sse)
}

        "contents": "&lt;!-- 955c7e55-e604-4504-8f1e-1e871402392f 85f2d8b8-f3ee-4840-bcee-e8c7680c078b --&gt;\n# TUI最新機能マージ計画\n\n## 概要\n\nupstream/mainからTUI関連の最新変更を取り込み、独自機能を保持しながらマージし、ビルドと起動テストまで実施します。\n\n## ステップ\n\n### Phase 1: 下準備と差分確認\n\n- &#96;git fetch upstream&#96; で最新mainを取得\n- &#96;git status&#96; / &#96;git diff upstream/main -- codex-rs/tui&#96; などで現状差分と独自変更を把握\n\n### Phase 2: マージ (ours優先ベース)\n\n- &#96;git merge upstream/main -X ours&#96; で全体を ours 優先でマージ\n- コンフリクトが発生したTUI関連ファイル（例: &#96;codex-rs/tui/src/**&#96;, &#96;codex-rs/tui/Cargo.toml&#96;, &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/main.rs&#96; のTUI起動ロジックなど）を個別に精査\n- 上流の新機能コードを取り込みつつ、独自機能や設定は維持（必要に応じて手動マージ）\n\n### Phase 3: ビルドと依存関係更新\n\n- &#96;just tui-build&#96; または &#96;cargo build --release -p codex-tui&#96;\n- 依存関係更新が必要な場合は &#96;cargo update -p &lt;crate&gt;&#96; で対応\n\n### Phase 4: 起動確認\n\n- &#96;codex tui&#96; でTUIを起動し、主要機能（画面表示、エージェント操作など）が動作するか手動確認\n\n### Phase 5: 実装ログ作成\n\n- &#96;_docs/&#96; に &#96;yyyy-mm-dd_TUI最新マージ完了.md&#96; を作成し、マージ内容・ビルド結果・起動確認結果・残課題を記録\n\n### To-dos\n\n- [ ] Phase 1.3: GUI-CLI通信拡張 - RPCメソッド追加 (resource.getStatus, resource.acquire, resource.release, cli.codex.execute, cli.gemini.execute, cli.claude.execute)\n- [ ] Phase 7.1: GeminiCLI MCP化拡張 - MCPサーバー起動とCodex統合改善\n- [ ] Phase 7.2: DeepResearch統合 - GeminiCLI経由のDeepResearch実行とGUI表示\n- [ ] Phase 8.1: /plan機能拡張 - Cursor風UI実装とPlanCreator.tsx作成\n- [ ] Phase 6.1: デスクトップ常駐機能拡張\n- [ ] Phase 6.2: 通知機能実装\n- [ ] Phase 4.3: アプリケーション作成インターフェース - AppCreator.tsx作成\n- [ ] Phase 4.4: インターネット接続機能実装",

        "contents": "---\nname: 公式最新変更取り込みと独自機能維持\noverview: 公式リポジトリ（upstream/main）の最新変更（新機能・脆弱性修正・バグ修正）を完全マージし、公式を優先しつつ独自機能（サブエージェント、Deep Research、オーケストレーション）を公式のAPIに合わせて再実装する\ntodos:\n  - id: fetch-upstream\n    content: 公式リポジトリの最新変更を取得（git fetch upstream）\n    status: completed\n  - id: merge-upstream\n    content: upstream/mainをマージ（競合解決は公式優先）\n    status: completed\n    dependencies:\n      - fetch-upstream\n  - id: update-dependencies\n    content: 依存関係を最新版に更新（clap, landlock, openssl-sys, test-log, tracing-opentelemetry）\n    status: completed\n    dependencies:\n      - merge-upstream\n  - id: fix-tui2-bugs\n    content: TUI2のバグ修正を取り込む（マウス選択境界、スクロール入力）\n    status: completed\n    dependencies:\n      - merge-upstream\n  - id: fix-panic-bugs\n    content: アルファ版でのパニック修正を取り込む\n    status: completed\n    dependencies:\n      - merge-upstream\n  - id: adapt-orchestration\n    content: orchestrationモジュールを公式APIに準拠させる（独自機能は維持）\n    status: completed\n    dependencies:\n      - merge-upstream\n  - id: adapt-subagents\n    content: sub-agent systemを公式APIに準拠させる（独自機能は維持）\n    status: completed\n    dependencies:\n      - merge-upstream\n  - id: mark-custom-features\n    content: plan機能など削除された機能を非公式機能として明確化\n    status: completed\n    dependencies:\n      - merge-upstream\n  - id: build-verify\n    content: ビルドを実行してエラー・警告を確認・修正\n    status: in_progress\n    dependencies:\n      - update-dependencies",

        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\.cursor\\plans\\公式最新変更取り込みと独自機能維持_4b92bb7a.plan.md",

            "line": 46
          }
        },
        "contents": "---\nname: 公式最新変更取り込みと独自機能維持\noverview: 公式リポジトリ（upstream/main）の最新変更（新機能・脆弱性修正・バグ修正）を取り込み、公式を優先しつつ独自機能（orchestration、agents、deep-research）を公式APIに準拠させて維持する。また、ビルド成果物などの雑多なファイルを.gitignoreに追加してコミット対象から除外する。\ntodos:\n  - id: update-gitignore\n    content: .gitignoreにtarget/を追加してビルド成果物を除外\n    status: completed\n  - id: unstage-build-artifacts\n    content: 既にステージングされているtarget/配下のファイルをアンステージ\n    status: completed\n  - id: fix-remaining-build-errors\n    content: 残っているビルドエラーを修正（型不一致、未解決インポートなど）\n    status: in_progress\n  - id: verify-orchestration-api\n    content: orchestrationモジュールが公式APIに準拠しているか確認・修正\n    status: pending\n  - id: verify-agents-api\n    content: agentsモジュールが公式APIに準拠しているか確認・修正\n    status: pending\n  - id: run-tests\n    content: cargo test --all-featuresでテストを実行し、失敗を修正\n    status: pending\n  - id: run-clippy\n    content: cargo clippy --all-features -- -D warningsで警告を確認・修正\n    status: pending\n---\n\n# 公式最新変更取り込みと独自機能維持プラン\n\n## 現状分析\n\n### 現在の状態\n\n- **ブランチ**: &#96;merge-upstream-2025-12-20&#96;\n- **マージ状況**: upstream/mainは既にマージ済み（HEAD..upstream/mainが空）\n- **問題点**: \n- &#96;target/fast/&#96; 配下のビルド成果物が大量にステージングされている\n- &#96;.gitignore&#96; に &#96;target/&#96; が含まれていない\n- ビルドエラーが残っている（前回のセッションから継続）\n\n### 公式の最新変更（既にマージ済み）\n\n1. **機能削除**\n\n- &#96;undo&#96;機能の削除 (#8424)\n- &#96;plan&#96;機能をsystem skillsから削除 (#8374)",

        "contents": "---\nname: upstream_merge_reconcile\noverview: fork(origin/main)に公式(upstream/main)の新機能/脆弱性修正/バグ修正を取り込みつつ、独自機能は「公式に同等機能が入ったら置き換え、無ければ維持」の方針でマージコンフリクトを解消し、最後にcodex-tuiをビルド→上書きインストール→実機確認→実装ログを残す。\ntodos:\n  - id: sync-upstream-merge\n    content: 作業ブランチで upstream/main を merge し、コンフリクトを解消する\n    status: completed\n  - id: reconcile-custom-features\n    content: 独自機能を upstream 同等機能へ置換/維持に仕分けし、差分を最小化する\n    status: in_progress\n  - id: build-install-test-tui\n    content: codex-tui を release でビルド→上書きインストール→入力/スラッシュコマンドを実機確認する\n    status: pending\n  - id: write-impl-log\n    content: _docs/ に所定フォーマットで実装ログを残す\n    status: pending\n---\n\n## 方針（今回の回答に基づく）\n\n- **統合方式**: &#96;merge&#96;（&#96;upstream/main&#96; を取り込むマージコミット）\n- **作業場所**: **作業ブランチ**で統合作業 → 最後に &#96;main&#96; へ反映\n- **独自機能の扱い**: \n- upstream に **同等機能が入っている**: upstream 実装へ寄せ、独自差分は削除/縮小\n- upstream に **同等機能が無い**: 独自実装を維持しつつ、upstream の設計に合わせて最小差分で乗せ直す\n\n## 事前確認（安全策）\n\n- 作業ツリーが汚れている可能性があるので、まず現状を保全する\n- &#96;git status&#96; で変更の有無を確認\n- 未コミットがあれば、作業ブランチ作成前に &#96;git stash push&#96; か「WIPコミット」で退避\n\n## 1) upstream の最新を取り込む（作業ブランチ）\n\n- &#96;git fetch upstream&#96; と &#96;git fetch origin&#96; で参照を最新化\n- &#96;main&#96; から作業ブランチ作成（例: &#96;merge-upstream-2025-12-20&#96;）\n- &#96;upstream/main&#96; を &#96;merge --no-ff&#96; で取り込み",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "---",

        "contents": "    status: pending\n---\n\n# 3ブランチマージと独自機能保持プラン\n\n## 現状分析\n\n### ブランチ状況\n\n- **現在のブランチ**: &#96;merge-upstream-2025-12-20&#96;\n- &#96;upstream/main&#96;は既にマージ済み\n- 最新コミット: &#96;86e0ef039&#96;\n- **origin/main**: 最新コミット &#96;8a93a25e3&#96; (GUI-CLI bridge統合など)\n- **main**: 最新コミット &#96;595426bf9&#96; (origin/mainより古い)\n- **共通祖先**: &#96;595426bf9&#96; (merge-upstream-2025-12-20とorigin/main/mainの共通点)\n\n### 保持すべき独自機能（zapabob/codex）\n\n1. **Deep Research機能** (&#96;codex-rs/deep-research/&#96;)\n2. **サブエージェントシステム** (&#96;.codex/agents/&#96;)\n\n- code-reviewer.yaml, researcher.yaml, sec-audit.yaml など8個\n\n3. **Orchestration機能拡張** (&#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/&#96;)\n\n- auto_orchestrator, collaboration_store, parallel_execution, plan_orchestrator\n\n4. **agentsモジュール** (&#96;codex-rs/core/src/agents/&#96;)\n\n- runtime, competition, types, loader, budgeter\n\n5. **plan機能** (&#96;codex-rs/core/src/plan/&#96;) - 公式では削除済みだが独自実装として維持\n6. **Gemini CLI MCP Server** (&#96;codex-rs/gemini-cli-mcp-server/&#96;)\n7. **MCPサーバーツール拡張** (7ツール)\n8. **日本語音声通知機能**\n9. **zapabobスクリプト群** (&#96;zapabob/scripts/&#96;)\n\n### 保持すべき公式機能\n\n- skills機能（公式の最新実装）\n- バグフィクス（upstream/mainから）\n- 不具合修正（origin/mainから）\n\n## 実装手順\n\n### Phase 1: 現状確認とバックアップ\n\n1. **作業前のバックアップ作成**\n\n- &#96;git branch backup-before-3way-merge-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)&#96;\n- 現在の作業ツリーの状態を保存\n\n2. **各ブランチの差分確認**\n\n- &#96;git diff merge-upstream-2025-12-20..origin/main&#96; - origin/mainの追加変更を確認\n- &#96;git diff merge-upstream-2025-12-20..main&#96; - mainの追加変更を確認\n- コンフリクト予測ファイルをリストアップ\n\n3. **独自機能ファイルの保護リスト作成**\n\n- Deep Research関連ファイル\n- Orchestration関連ファイル",

        "contents": "# Codex v0.48.0 改良案リスト（実装ログから抽出）\n\n## 📋 抽出元\n- &#96;_docs/2025-10-16_05-07-09_音声通知設定_CodexとCursorの使い分け.md&#96;\n- &#96;_docs/2025-10-16_完全実装完了_最終報告.md&#96;\n- &#96;_docs/2025-10-15_ClaudeCode超え完成.md&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 改良案リスト\n\n### 1️⃣ 音声通知機能の改良\n\n#### 優先度: 中\n#### カテゴリ: UX改善\n\n**現状の課題:**\n- Cursor用スクリプト &#96;play-completion-sound.ps1&#96; が現在霊夢音声を使用\n- 魔理沙音声ファイルのパスが未確認（ファイルが見つからない）\n- Windows System通知音が手動設定のみ\n\n**改良案:**\n1. **Cursor用スクリプトの魔理沙化**\n   - &#96;play-completion-sound.ps1&#96; を魔理沙音声に変更\n   - ファイルパス確認後に実装\n   - 既存の霊夢音声はCodex CLI専用に維持\n\n2. **Windows System設定の自動化**\n   - &#96;set-windows-notification-sound.ps1&#96; の改良\n   - レジストリパス自動検出機能追加\n   - エラーハンドリング強化\n\n3. **追加キャラクター対応**\n   - 早苗、咲夜、妖夢などの音声追加\n   - キャラクター選択機能の実装\n   - &#96;config.toml&#96; でキャラクター切り替え可能に\n\n**実装ファイル:**\n- &#96;zapabob/scripts/play-completion-sound.ps1&#96;\n- &#96;zapabob/scripts/set-windows-notification-sound.ps1&#96;\n- &#96;config.toml&#96; (新規 &#96;[sounds]&#96; セクション)\n\n**期待効果:**\n- ユーザー体験の向上\n- キャラクターの使い分けによる視認性向上\n- 自動設定による導入障壁の低減\n\n---\n\n### 2️⃣ ThreeWayMerge の実装\n\n#### 優先度: 高\n#### カテゴリ: コア機能\n\n**現状の課題:**\n- &#96;MergeStrategy::ThreeWayMerge&#96; が未実装\n- コメント: \"// TODO: Implement 3-way merge logic\"\n- 現在は &#96;Sequential&#96; と &#96;LastWriteWins&#96; のみサポート\n\n**改良案:**\n1. **Git-style 3-way merge アルゴリズム実装**\n   - Base（共通祖先）、Ours（Agent A）、Theirs（Agent B）の3つを比較",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "# Codex Sub-Agents &amp; Deep Research - Cursor 実装計画書\n\n**ステータス**: Draft  \n**作成日**: 2025-10-12 (JST)  \n**対象**: Codex Core, CLI/IDE, Supervisor, Deep Research チーム  \n**バージョン**: v0.1.0\n\n---\n\n## 📋 エグゼクティブサマリー\n\n本ドキュメントは、&#96;codex-main/codex-rs&#96; ワークスペースにおけるサブエージェント機構と Deep Research 機能を本番品質で統合するための実装計画を定義します。既存の MVP 実装（M1 完了）を基に、M2～M4 フェーズで段階的に機能を拡充し、GA（General Availability）を目指します。\n\n### 主要目標\n\n1. **サブエージェント機構の本番化**: &#96;.codex/agents/*.yaml&#96; ベースのエージェント定義、トークン動的配分、並列実行、PR 分割を安定化\n2. **Deep Research v1 の統合**: 計画生成→探索→反証→出典必須レポートのパイプラインを完成させ、軽量版フォールバックと MCP 連携を実装\n3. **ガバナンスとセキュリティ**: Budgeter 強化、監査ログ永続化、権限ポリシー厳密化\n4. **CLI/IDE/Web/GitHub/Slack 動線の拡張**: 既存インターフェースを壊さずプラガブルに機能を追加\n\n### 現状サマリー\n\n| コンポーネント | ステータス | 課題 |\n|---------------|-----------|------|\n| **AgentDefinition/Loader** | ✅ 実装完了 | キャッシュの TTL 管理なし |\n| **TokenBudgeter** | ✅ 実装完了 | トークン消費の監査ログ未連携 |\n| **AgentRuntime** | ⚠️ 部分実装 | MCP ツール連携が実験的 |\n| **Deep Research (Planner)** | ✅ 実装完了 | 軽量版フォールバックのロジック改善余地 |\n| **Deep Research (Pipeline)** | ⚠️ 部分実装 | 反証チェックの精度向上が必要 |\n| **CLI (delegate)** | ✅ 実装完了 | エラーハンドリングの改善 |\n| **CLI (research)** | ⚠️ 部分実装 | Gemini CLI 統合が実験的 |\n| **Supervisor** | ✅ 実装完了 | Deep Research 結果との統合未完 |\n| **監査ログ** | ⚠️ 部分実装 | 永続化ストレージ未設定 |",

    create_shell_sse_response(command, workdir, timeout_ms, call_id)
}

/// Create SSE response for exec_command (unified_exec tool)
pub fn create_exec_command_sse_response(
    command: Vec<String>,
    workdir: Option<&Path>,
    timeout_ms: Option<u64>,
    call_id: &str,
) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
    // The `arguments` for the `unified_exec` tool is a serialized JSON object.
    let tool_call_arguments = serde_json::to_string(&json!({
        "command": command,
        "workdir": workdir.map(|w| w.to_string_lossy()),
        "timeout": timeout_ms
    }))?;
    let tool_call = json!({
        "choices": [
            {
                "delta": {
                    "tool_calls": [
                        {
                            "id": call_id,
                            "function": {
                                "name": "unified_exec",
                                "arguments": tool_call_arguments
                            }
                        }
                    ]
                },
                "finish_reason": "tool_calls"
            }
        ]
    });

    let sse = format!(
        "data: {}\n\ndata: DONE\n\n",
        serde_json::to_string(&tool_call)?
    );
    Ok(sse)
}
```

</details>

</tool-use>

        "contents": "## Install &amp; build\n\n### System requirements\n\n| Requirement                 | Details                                                         |\n| --------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |\n| Operating systems           | macOS 12+, Ubuntu 20.04+/Debian 10+, or Windows 11 **via WSL2** |\n| Git (optional, recommended) | 2.23+ for built-in PR helpers                                   |\n| RAM                         | 4-GB minimum (8-GB recommended)                                 |\n\n### DotSlash\n\nThe GitHub Release also contains a [DotSlash](https://dotslash-cli.com/) file for the Codex CLI named &#96;codex&#96;. Using a DotSlash file makes it possible to make a lightweight commit to source control to ensure all contributors use the same version of an executable, regardless of what platform they use for development.\n\n### Build from source\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Clone the repository and navigate to the root of the Cargo workspace.\ngit clone https://github.com/openai/codex.git\ncd codex/codex-rs\n\n# Install the Rust toolchain, if necessary.\ncurl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y\nsource \"$HOME/.cargo/env\"\nrustup component add rustfmt\nrustup component add clippy\n# Install helper tools used by the workspace justfile:\ncargo install just\n# Optional: install nextest for the &#96;just test&#96; helper (or use &#96;cargo test --all-features&#96; as a fallback)\ncargo install cargo-nextest\n\n# Build Codex.\ncargo build\n\n# Launch the TUI with a sample prompt.\ncargo run --bin codex -- \"explain this codebase to me\"\n\n# After making changes, use the root justfile helpers (they default to codex-rs):\njust fmt\njust fix -p &lt;crate-you-touched&gt;\n\n# Run the relevant tests (project-specific is fastest), for example:\ncargo test -p codex-tui\n# If you have cargo-nextest installed, &#96;just test&#96; runs the full suite:\njust test\n# Otherwise, fall back to:\ncargo test --all-features\n&#96;&#96;&#96;",

        "contents": "# Codex Build &amp; Install Guide\n\n**対象**: codex-rs (Rust workspace)  \n**最終更新**: 2025-10-12\n\n---\n\n## 🚀 クイックスタート\n\n### Option 1: 自動ビルド &amp; インストール（推奨）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# codex-main ディレクトリまたは codex-rs ディレクトリから実行\n.\\codex-rs\\clean-build-install.ps1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Option 2: エラー時の緊急修復\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n.\\codex-rs\\emergency-repair.ps1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 📋 詳細手順\n\n### 1. 手動ビルド &amp; インストール\n\n#### ステップ1: ディレクトリ移動\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\ncd C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\codex-main\\codex-main\\codex-rs\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### ステップ2: クリーンビルド\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\ncargo clean\ncargo build --release -p codex-cli\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### ステップ3: グローバルインストール\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# 既存プロセスを停止\nGet-Process codex -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force\n\n# インストール\nCopy-Item .\\target\\release\\codex.exe $env:USERPROFILE\\.cargo\\bin\\codex.exe -Force\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### ステップ4: 動作確認\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\ncodex --version\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🛠️ スクリプト詳細\n\n### clean-build-install.ps1\n\n**機能**:\n- ✅ 自動ディレクトリ検出（どこから実行しても OK）\n- ✅ ワークスペース検証\n- ✅ クリーンビルド（オプション）\n- ✅ コードフォーマット（just fmt / cargo fmt）\n- ✅ リリースビルド\n- ✅ バイナリ確認\n- ✅ グローバルインストール（リトライ3回）\n- ✅ 動作確認\n\n**オプション**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# クリーンをスキップ（高速化）\n.\\clean-build-install.ps1 -SkipClean\n\n# 詳細ログ表示\n.\\clean-build-install.ps1 -Verbose\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**出力**:\n- ログファイル: &#96;clean-build-install.log&#96;\n- バックアップ: &#96;~/.cargo/bin/codex.exe.backup-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS&#96;\n\n### emergency-repair.ps1\n\n**機能**:\n- ✅ 実行中プロセスの診断と停止\n- ✅ Cargo.lock のクリーン\n- ✅ target ディレクトリのクリーンアップ\n- ✅ 古いバックアップの削除\n- ✅ リリースビルド（エラー自動修復）",

        "contents": "# Codex Tauri - Installation Guide\n\nComplete installation guide for Codex AI-Native OS resident GUI client.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n### Required Software\n\n1. **Node.js 18+**\n   - Download: https://nodejs.org/\n   - Verify: &#96;node --version&#96;\n\n2. **Rust 1.70+**\n   - Download: https://rustup.rs/\n   - Verify: &#96;rustc --version&#96;\n\n3. **Windows 10/11**\n   - Visual Studio Build Tools 2019+ (for native modules)\n   - Windows SDK\n\n### Optional (for Development)\n\n- Git\n- Visual Studio Code with Rust Analyzer extension\n\n## Installation from MSI\n\n### Step 1: Download Installer\n\nDownload the latest &#96;Codex_0.1.0_x64.msi&#96; from:\n- GitHub Releases (when available)\n- Or build from source (see below)\n\n### Step 2: Run Installer\n\n1. Double-click the MSI file\n2. Follow the installation wizard\n3. Choose installation directory (default: &#96;C:\\Program Files\\Codex&#96;)\n4. Complete installation\n\n### Step 3: First Launch\n\n1. Find \"Codex\" in Start Menu\n2. Or look for system tray icon (running in background)\n3. Right-click tray icon → \"Dashboard を開く\"\n\n## Building from Source\n\n### Step 1: Clone Repository\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd C:\\Users\\YourName\\Projects\ngit clone https://github.com/zapabob/codex.git\ncd codex/codex-tauri\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 2: Install Dependencies\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\nnpm install\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: Build Application\n\n#### Development Build (faster)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\nnpm run tauri:dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Production Build (optimized)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n.\\build.ps1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nOr manually:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\nnpm run tauri build\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Find Installer\n\nMSI installer will be located at:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\ncodex-tauri\\src-tauri\\target\\release\\bundle\\msi\\Codex_0.1.0_x64.msi\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Post-Installation Setup\n\n### 1. Configure Workspace\n\n1. Open Codex Dashboard\n2. Go to Dashboard page\n3. Enter your workspace path (e.g., &#96;C:\\Users\\YourName\\Projects\\myproject&#96;)\n4. Click \"Start Monitoring\"\n\n### 2. Enable Auto-start (Optional)\n\n1. Go to Settings\n2. Toggle \"Auto-start on Windows boot\"\n3. Codex will launch automatically on next boot\n\n### 3. Configure Codex Core",

        "contents": "# Codex Tauri - Installation Guide\n\nComplete installation guide for Codex AI-Native OS resident GUI client.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n### Required Software\n\n1. **Node.js 18+**\n   - Download: https://nodejs.org/\n   - Verify: &#96;node --version&#96;\n\n2. **Rust 1.70+**\n   - Download: https://rustup.rs/\n   - Verify: &#96;rustc --version&#96;\n\n3. **Windows 10/11**\n   - Visual Studio Build Tools 2019+ (for native modules)\n   - Windows SDK\n\n### Optional (for Development)\n\n- Git\n- Visual Studio Code with Rust Analyzer extension\n\n## Installation from MSI\n\n### Step 1: Download Installer\n\nDownload the latest &#96;Codex_0.1.0_x64.msi&#96; from:\n- GitHub Releases (when available)\n- Or build from source (see below)\n\n### Step 2: Run Installer\n\n1. Double-click the MSI file\n2. Follow the installation wizard\n3. Choose installation directory (default: &#96;C:\\Program Files\\Codex&#96;)\n4. Complete installation\n\n### Step 3: First Launch\n\n1. Find \"Codex\" in Start Menu\n2. Or look for system tray icon (running in background)\n3. Right-click tray icon → \"Dashboard を開く\"\n\n## Building from Source\n\n### Step 1: Clone Repository\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd C:\\Users\\YourName\\Projects\ngit clone https://github.com/zapabob/codex.git\ncd codex/codex-tauri\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 2: Install Dependencies\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\nnpm install\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: Build Application\n\n#### Development Build (faster)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\nnpm run tauri:dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Production Build (optimized)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n.\\build.ps1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nOr manually:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\nnpm run tauri build\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Find Installer\n\nMSI installer will be located at:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\ncodex-tauri\\src-tauri\\target\\release\\bundle\\msi\\Codex_0.1.0_x64.msi\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Post-Installation Setup\n\n### 1. Configure Workspace\n\n1. Open Codex Dashboard\n2. Go to Dashboard page\n3. Enter your workspace path (e.g., &#96;C:\\Users\\YourName\\Projects\\myproject&#96;)\n4. Click \"Start Monitoring\"\n\n### 2. Enable Auto-start (Optional)\n\n1. Go to Settings\n2. Toggle \"Auto-start on Windows boot\"\n3. Codex will launch automatically on next boot\n\n### 3. Configure Codex Core",

        "contents": "# Codex Fast Build &amp; Install Script\n# Enforces zero warnings, performs differential build, and overwrites installation.\n\n$ErrorActionPreference = \"Stop\"\n$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'\n\nfunction Write-Status {\n    param([string]$Message, [string]$Color = \"Cyan\")\n    Write-Host \"[*] $Message\" -ForegroundColor $Color\n}\n\nfunction Write-Success {\n    param([string]$Message)\n    Write-Host \"[OK] $Message\" -ForegroundColor Green\n}\n\nfunction Write-ErrorMsg {\n    param([string]$Message)\n    Write-Host \"[ERROR] $Message\" -ForegroundColor Red\n}\n\n# Ensure we are in the right directory\nif (-not (Test-Path \"Cargo.toml\")) {\n    Write-ErrorMsg \"Cargo.toml not found. Please run this script from the codex-rs directory.\"\n    exit 1\n}\n\n$env:RUSTFLAGS = \"-D warnings\"\n\n# Step 1: Type Check &amp; Linting (Zero Warnings)\nWrite-Status \"Step 1/4: Checking types and lints (Zero Warnings)...\"\ntry {\n    cargo check --workspace --all-targets --quiet\n    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw \"Cargo check failed\" }\n    Write-Success \"Type check passed with 0 warnings.\"\n} catch {\n    Write-ErrorMsg \"Type check failed or warnings found.\"\n    exit 1\n}\n\n# Step 2: Differential Build\nWrite-Status \"Step 2/4: Building codex-cli (Release, Incremental)...\"\ntry {\n    cargo build --release --package codex-cli --quiet\n    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw \"Build failed\" }\n    Write-Success \"Build completed.\"\n} catch {\n    Write-ErrorMsg \"Build failed.\"\n    exit 1\n}\n\n# Step 3: Kill Existing Processes\nWrite-Status \"Step 3/4: Stopping running codex processes...\"\n$CodexProcesses = Get-Process codex -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\nif ($CodexProcesses) {\n    $CodexProcesses | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\n    Start-Sleep -Seconds 1\n    Write-Success \"Processes stopped.\"\n} else {\n    Write-Success \"No running processes found.\"\n}\n\n# Step 4: Overwrite Install\nWrite-Status \"Step 4/4: Installing binary...\"\n$SourcePath = \".\\target\\release\\codex.exe\"\n$InstallPath = \"$env:USERPROFILE\\.cargo\\bin\\codex.exe\"",

        "contents": "**⚡ CUDA Runtime** - GPU acceleration everywhere\n- Git analysis: 100x faster\n- 3D rendering: Real-time 120fps\n- LLM inference: (Roadmap for v2.2.0)\n- Multi-GPU support: (Roadmap)\n\n**🤖 Enhanced Sub-Agent System** - 8+ specialized agents\n- Parallel execution: 2.6x faster\n- Collaboration store: Agent communication\n- Conflict resolution: 3 merge strategies\n- Custom agent creation: YAML-driven\n\n**🔍 Deep Research Engine** - Multi-source validation\n- 15+ MCP servers integrated\n- Citation management\n- Contradiction detection\n- 45x faster with caching\n\n**🚀 CI/CD Pipeline v2.2.0** - Complete Automation with npm Publishing\n- GitHub Actions workflows: Rust CI, Release CI, Security CI, Docs CI\n- Multi-platform builds: Windows, macOS, Linux (x64/ARM64)\n- Automated testing: Unit, Integration, E2E\n- Security scanning: cargo-audit, CVE detection\n- Auto-deployment: Binary generation, npm packaging, GitHub Releases\n\n---\n\n### 📦 Installation\n\n#### Option 1: npm (Recommended) ⭐\n\n**Available on npm**: [@zapabob/codex](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zapabob/codex)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Install globally\nnpm install -g @zapabob/codex\n\n# Verify installation\ncodex --version  # codex-cli 2.2.0\n\n# Update to latest version\nnpm update -g @zapabob/codex\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Features**:\n- ✅ Pre-built binaries for 8 platforms (Windows/macOS/Linux x64/ARM64)\n- ✅ Automatic platform detection\n- ✅ One-command installation\n- ✅ Automatic updates via npm\n\n#### Option 2: Cargo (From source)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Prerequisites\nrustup install stable\ncargo install just\n\n# Clone repository\ngit clone https://github.com/zapabob/codex.git\ncd codex/codex-rs\n\n# Build and install\ncargo build --release -p codex-cli\ncargo install --path cli --force\n\n# Verify\ncodex --version\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Option 3: Binary releases\n\nDownload pre-built binaries from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/zapabob/codex/releases):\n\n- **Windows**: &#96;codex-windows-x64.exe&#96;\n- **macOS**: &#96;codex-macos-x64&#96; (Intel), &#96;codex-macos-arm64&#96; (Apple Silicon)\n- **Linux**: &#96;codex-linux-x64&#96;\n\n---\n\n### 🚀 Quick Start",

-ForegroundColor Yellow\n    Set-Location codex-rs\n    cargo build --release --bin codex\n    Set-Location ..\n    \n    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {\n        Write-Host \"Build successful!\" -ForegroundColor Green\n    } else {\n        Write-Host \"Build failed!\" -ForegroundColor Red\n        exit 1\n    }\n}\n\n# Step 2: Create bin directory in codex-cli\nWrite-Host \"&#96;nStep 2:         "contents": "      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.90\n        with:\n          targets: ${{ matrix.target }}\n\n      - uses: actions/cache@v5\n        with:\n          path: |\n            ~/.cargo/bin/\n            ~/.cargo/registry/index/\n            ~/.cargo/registry/cache/\n            ~/.cargo/git/db/\n            ${{ github.workspace }}/codex-rs/target/\n          key: cargo-${{ matrix.runner }}-${{ matrix.target }}-release-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}\n\n      - if: ${{ matrix.target == 'x86_64-unknown-linux-musl' || matrix.target == 'aarch64-unknown-linux-musl'}}\n        name: Install musl build tools\n        run: |\n          sudo apt-get update\n          sudo apt-get install -y musl-tools pkg-config\n\n      - name: Cargo build\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          if [[ \"${{ contains(matrix.target, 'windows') }}\" == 'true' ]]; then\n            cargo build --target ${{ matrix.target }} --release --bin codex --bin codex-responses-api-proxy --bin codex-windows-sandbox-setup --bin codex-command-runner\n          else\n            cargo build --target ${{ matrix.target }} --release --bin codex --bin codex-responses-api-proxy\n          fi\n\n      - if: ${{ contains(matrix.target, 'linux') }}\n        name: Cosign Linux artifacts\n        uses: ./.github/actions/linux-code-sign\n        with:\n          target: ${{ matrix.target }}\n          artifacts-dir: ${{ github.workspace }}/codex-rs/target/${{ matrix.target }}/release\n\n      - if: ${{ contains(matrix.target, 'windows') }}\n        name: Sign Windows binaries with Azure Trusted Signing\n        uses: ./.github/actions/windows-code-sign\n        with:\n          target: ${{ matrix.target }}",

        "contents": "// Build binary\nasync function buildBinary() {\n  status('Building release (codex-cli)...');\n  if (skipClean) {\n    log('   [INFO] Using incremental build (faster)...', 'cyan');\n  } else {\n    log('   [INFO] Full build (this may take several minutes)...', 'yellow');\n  }\n\n  const buildStart = Date.now();\n  const buildArgs = ['build', '--release', '-p', 'codex-cli'];\n\n  try {\n    await runCommand('cargo', buildArgs, { cwd: codexRsPath });\n    const buildDuration = Date.now() - buildStart;\n    const buildMinutes = Math.round((buildDuration / 1000 / 60) * 10) / 10;\n    const buildSeconds = Math.round(buildDuration / 1000);\n    log(&#96;   Build time: ${buildMinutes}m ${buildSeconds}s&#96;, 'gray');\n    success('Build succeeded!');\n    return true;\n  } catch (err) {\n    error('Build failed');\n    if (err.stdout) {\n      console.error(err.stdout);\n    }\n    if (err.stderr) {\n      console.error(err.stderr);\n    }\n\n    // Special handling for build errors - check for existing binary\n    status('Build failed, checking for existing binary...');\n    \n    if (fs.existsSync(targetReleasePath)) {\n      warning('Found existing binary. Using it');\n      return true;\n    } else if (fs.existsSync(targetDebugPath)) {\n      warning('Found debug binary. Using it');\n      return true;\n    } else {\n      error('Cannot continue build - no existing binary found');\n      log('\\nSuggested fixes:', 'yellow');\n      log('  1. Install Visual Studio Build Tools', 'reset');\n      log('  2. Run: cargo update -p aws-lc-sys', 'reset');\n      log('  3. Or use existing binary: npm run build:binary (if binary exists)', 'reset');\n      log('  4. Re-run this script', 'reset');\n      process.exit(1);\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// Copy binary to bin directory\nfunction copyBinary() {\n  status('Copying binary to bin directory...');\n}",

        "contents": "function Invoke-Tests {\n    if ($SkipTests) {\n        Write-Info \"Skipping tests as requested\"\n        return $true\n    }\n\n    Write-Step \"Running tests...\"\n\n    $testResult = &amp; cargo test --release --workspace --exclude codex-tui 2&gt;&amp;1\n    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {\n        Write-Error \"Tests failed:&#96;n$testResult\"\n        return $false\n    }\n\n    Write-Success \"All tests passed\"\n    return $true\n}\n\n# Function to install binaries\nfunction Install-Binaries {\n    Write-Step \"Installing binaries...\"\n\n    # Install CLI\n    $installResult = &amp; cargo install --path codex-rs/cli --force\n    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {\n        Write-Error \"CLI installation failed\"\n        return $false\n    }\n\n    # Install TUI (if available)\n    if (Test-Path \"codex-rs\\tui\") {\n        try {\n            Copy-Item -Path \"codex-rs\\target\\release\\codex-tui.exe\" -Destination \"$env:USERPROFILE\\.cargo\\bin\\\" -Force\n            Write-Info \"Installed TUI binary\"\n        } catch {\n            Write-Error \"Failed to install TUI binary: $_\"\n        }\n    }\n\n    Write-Success \"Installation completed\"\n    return $true\n}\n\n# Function to verify installation\nfunction Test-Installation {\n    Write-Step \"Verifying installation...\"\n\n    $versionCheck = &amp; codex --version 2&gt;&amp;1\n    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {\n        Write-Success \"Codex version: $versionCheck\"\n        return $true\n    } else {\n        Write-Error \"Version check failed: $versionCheck\"\n        return $false\n    }\n}\n\n# Function to rollback on failure\nfunction Invoke-Rollback {\n    Write-Step \"Rolling back to previous version...\"",

        "contents": "# Phase 2 Complete Build and Install Script\n# Clean build, release build, and global install\n\nWrite-Host \"=== Phase 2 Complete Build and Install ===\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\n# Step 1: Navigate to codex-rs\nWrite-Host \"[Step 1/4] Navigating to codex-rs...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\nSet-Location -Path \"codex-rs\"\nWrite-Host \"  Current directory: $(Get-Location)\" -ForegroundColor Gray\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\n# Step 2: Clean build\nWrite-Host \"[Step 2/4] Clean build...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\ncargo clean\nWrite-Host \"  Clean completed\" -ForegroundColor Green\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\n# Step 3: Release build (with stability options)\nWrite-Host \"[Step 3/4] Release build with stability options (single-threaded, no incremental)...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\nWrite-Host \"  This will take 15-20 minutes but is more stable...\" -ForegroundColor Gray\n$buildStart = Get-Date\ncargo build --release -p codex-cli -j 1\n$buildEnd = Get-Date\n$buildDuration = ($buildEnd - $buildStart).TotalMinutes\n\nif ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {\n    Write-Host \"  Build completed in $([math]::Round($buildDuration, 2)) minutes\" -ForegroundColor Green\n} else {\n    Write-Host \"  Build failed!\" -ForegroundColor Red\n    Set-Location -Path \"..\"\n    exit 1\n}\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\n# Step 4: Global install\nWrite-Host \"[Step 4/4] Global install...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\ncargo install --path cli --force\n\nif ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {\n    Write-Host \"  Install completed\" -ForegroundColor Green\n} else {\n    Write-Host \"  Install failed!\" -ForegroundColor Red\n    Set-Location -Path \"..\"\n    exit 1\n}\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\n# Return to parent directory\nSet-Location -Path \"..\"\n\n# Verification\nWrite-Host \"=== Verification ===\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\nWrite-Host \"Codex version:\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\ncodex --version\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\nWrite-Host \"MCP server check:\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\ncodex mcp-server --help | Select-Object -First 3\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\nWrite-Host \"MCP list:\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\ncodex mcp list\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\nWrite-Host \"=== Phase 2 Build Complete! ===\" -ForegroundColor Green\nWrite-Host \"\"\nWrite-Host \"Next steps:\" -ForegroundColor Cyan",

        "contents": "// Main function\nasync function main() {\n  log('========================================', 'cyan');\n  log(' Codex Build &amp; Install', 'cyan');\n  log('========================================', 'cyan');\n  log('');\n\n  // Step 1: Kill processes\n  status('Step 1/3: Stopping running processes...');\n  killProcesses();\n  log('');\n\n  // Step 2: Build\n  status('Step 2/3: Building binary...');\n  const buildSuccess = await buildBinary();\n  if (!buildSuccess) {\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n  log('');\n\n  // Step 3: Install globally (optional)\n  if (globalInstall) {\n    status('Step 3/3: Installing globally...');\n    await installGlobally();\n  } else {\n    status('Step 3/3: Skipping global install (use --global to install)');\n  }\n  log('');\n\n  log('========================================', 'green');\n  log('  Build &amp; Install Completed!', 'green');\n  log('========================================', 'green');\n  log('');\n  log(&#96;Binary: ${path.join(binPath, binaryName)}&#96;, 'cyan');\n  if (globalInstall) {\n    const homeDir = process.env.USERPROFILE || process.env.HOME || '';\n    log(&#96;Global: ${path.join(homeDir, '.cargo', 'bin', binaryName)}&#96;, 'cyan');\n  }\n  log('');\n  log('Next steps:', 'yellow');\n  log('  codex --version', 'reset');\n  log('  npx @zapabob/codex --version', 'reset');\n  log('  pnpm exec codex --version', 'reset');\n  log('');\n}\n\n// Run main\nmain().catch((err) =&gt; {\n  error(&#96;Fatal error: ${err.message}&#96;);\n}",

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "#### 実装ログ作成手順",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **日時取得**",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "    - MCPサーバーが利用可能な場合はMCP経由で取得",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {

          {
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **ファイル名の決定**",

            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **ログ作成**",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 実装例",

          },
          {
            "text": "# 1. 現在日時を取得",

          },
          {
            "text": "$currentDateTime = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "text": "$currentDate = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd\"",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },

          },

        "contents": "# Codex MCP Server Interface [experimental]\n\nThis document describes Codex’s experimental MCP server interface: a JSON‑RPC API that runs over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) transport to control a local Codex engine.\n\n- Status: experimental and subject to change without notice\n- Server binary: &#96;codex mcp-server&#96; (or &#96;codex-mcp-server&#96;)\n- Transport: standard MCP over stdio (JSON‑RPC 2.0, line‑delimited)\n\n## Overview\n\nCodex exposes a small set of MCP‑compatible methods to create and manage conversations, send user input, receive live events, and handle approval prompts. The types are defined in &#96;protocol/src/mcp_protocol.rs&#96; and re‑used by the MCP server implementation in &#96;mcp-server/&#96;.\n\nAt a glance:\n\n- Conversations\n  - &#96;newConversation&#96; → start a Codex session\n  - &#96;sendUserMessage&#96; / &#96;sendUserTurn&#96; → send user input into a conversation\n  - &#96;interruptConversation&#96; → stop the current turn\n  - &#96;listConversations&#96;, &#96;resumeConversation&#96;, &#96;archiveConversation&#96;\n- Configuration and info\n  - &#96;getUserSavedConfig&#96;, &#96;setDefaultModel&#96;, &#96;getUserAgent&#96;, &#96;userInfo&#96;\n  - &#96;model/list&#96; → enumerate available models and reasoning options\n- Auth\n  - &#96;account/read&#96;, &#96;account/login/start&#96;, &#96;account/login/cancel&#96;, &#96;account/logout&#96;, &#96;account/rateLimits/read&#96;\n  - notifications: &#96;account/login/completed&#96;, &#96;account/updated&#96;, &#96;account/rateLimits/updated&#96;\n- Utilities\n  - &#96;gitDiffToRemote&#96;, &#96;execOneOffCommand&#96;\n- Approvals (server → client requests)\n  - &#96;applyPatchApproval&#96;, &#96;execCommandApproval&#96;\n- Notifications (server → client)\n  - &#96;loginChatGptComplete&#96;, &#96;authStatusChange&#96;\n  - &#96;codex/event&#96; stream with agent events\n\nSee code for full type definitions and exact shapes: &#96;protocol/src/mcp_protocol.rs&#96;.\n\n## Starting the server\n\nRun Codex as an MCP server and connect an MCP client:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncodex mcp-server | your_mcp_client\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nFor a simple inspection UI, you can also try:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector codex mcp-server\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nUse the separate &#96;codex mcp&#96; subcommand to manage configured MCP server launchers in &#96;config.toml&#96;.\n\n## Conversations\n\nStart a new session with optional overrides:",

        "contents": "async fn send_message(\n    State(state): State&lt;AppState&gt;,\n    Path(conversation_id): Path&lt;String&gt;,\n    Json(request): Json&lt;SendMessageRequest&gt;,\n) -&gt; Result&lt;Json&lt;Message&gt;, GuiError&gt; {\n    let message = Message {\n        id: Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),\n        role: request.role.unwrap_or_else(|| \"user\".to_string()),\n        content: request.content.clone(),\n        timestamp: Utc::now(),\n    };\n\n    // Add message to conversation\n    let mut messages = state.messages.write().await;\n    let conversation_messages = messages\n        .entry(conversation_id.clone())\n        .or_insert_with(Vec::new);\n    conversation_messages.push(message.clone());\n\n    // Update conversation metadata\n    let mut conversations = state.conversations.write().await;\n    if let Some(conversation) = conversations.iter_mut().find(|c| c.id == conversation_id) {\n        conversation.last_activity = Utc::now();\n        conversation.message_count += 1;\n    }\n\n    Ok(Json(message))\n}\n\nasync fn get_current_user(State(state): State&lt;AppState&gt;) -&gt; Json&lt;Option&lt;User&gt;&gt; {\n    let user = state.current_user.read().await.clone();\n\n    // If no user is set, create a default user\n    if user.is_none() {\n        let default_user = User {\n            id: \"default-user\".to_string(),\n            name: \"Codex User\".to_string(),\n            email: \"user@codex.local\".to_string(),\n            avatar_url: None,\n        };\n\n        let mut current_user = state.current_user.write().await;\n        *current_user = Some(default_user.clone());\n        return Json(Some(default_user));\n    }\n\n    Json(user)\n}",

        "contents": ",\n        git_info,\n    })\n}\n\nfn extract_conversation_summary(\n    path: PathBuf,\n    head: &amp;[serde_json::Value],\n    session_meta: &amp;SessionMeta,\n    git: Option&lt;&amp;CoreGitInfo&gt;,\n    fallback_provider: &amp;str,\n) -&gt; Option&lt;ConversationSummary&gt; {\n    let preview = head\n        .iter()\n        .filter_map(|value| serde_json::from_value::&lt;ResponseItem&gt;(value.clone()).ok())\n        .find_map(|item| match codex_core::parse_turn_item(&amp;item) {\n            Some(TurnItem::UserMessage(user)) =&gt; Some(user.message()),\n            _ =&gt; None,\n        })?;\n\n    let preview = match preview.find(USER_MESSAGE_BEGIN) {\n        Some(idx) =&gt; preview[idx + USER_MESSAGE_BEGIN.len()..].trim(),\n        None =&gt; preview.as_str(),\n    };\n\n    let timestamp = if session_meta.timestamp.is_empty() {\n        None\n    } else {\n        Some(session_meta.timestamp.clone())\n    };\n    let conversation_id = session_meta.id;\n    let model_provider = session_meta\n        .model_provider\n        .clone()\n        .unwrap_or_else(|| fallback_provider.to_string());\n    let git_info = git.map(map_git_info);\n\n    Some(ConversationSummary {\n        conversation_id,\n        timestamp,\n        path,\n        preview: preview.to_string(),\n        model_provider,\n        cwd: session_meta.cwd.clone(),\n        cli_version: session_meta.cli_version.clone(),\n        source: session_meta.source.clone(),\n        git_info,\n    })\n}\n\nfn map_git_info(git_info: &amp;CoreGitInfo) -&gt; ConversationGitInfo {\n    ConversationGitInfo {\n        sha: git_info.commit_hash.clone(),\n        branch: git_info.branch.clone(),\n        origin_url: git_info.repository_url.clone(),\n    }\n}\n\nfn parse_datetime(timestamp: Option&lt;&amp;str&gt;) -&gt; Option&lt;DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;&gt; {\n    timestamp.and_then(|ts| {\n        chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(ts)\n            .ok()\n            .map(|dt| dt.with_timezone(&amp;chrono::Utc))\n    })\n}\n\nfn summary_to_thread(summary: ConversationSummary) -&gt; Thread",

        "contents": "//! MCP Registry for Windows 11 25H2\n//!\n//! Provides a secure, standardized registry for AI agents to discover\n//! and connect to MCP servers on Windows 11.\n\nuse std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\nuse tokio::sync::{mpsc, oneshot};\nuse crate::Result;\n\n/// MCP Server metadata\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct MCPServerInfo {\n    /// Unique server identifier\n    pub id: String,\n    /// Human-readable name\n    pub name: String,\n    /// Server description\n    pub description: String,\n    /// Version information\n    pub version: String,\n    /// Capabilities provided by this server\n    pub capabilities: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n    /// Connection endpoint\n    pub endpoint: String,\n    /// Authentication requirements\n    pub auth_required: bool,\n    /// Security level\n    pub security_level: SecurityLevel,\n    /// Resource requirements\n    pub resource_requirements: ResourceRequirements,\n    /// Last seen timestamp\n    pub last_seen: chrono::DateTime&lt;chrono::Utc&gt;,\n}\n\n/// Security levels for MCP servers\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub enum SecurityLevel {\n    /// High trust - system services\n    System,\n    /// Medium trust - verified third-party\n    Verified,\n    /// Low trust - unverified\n    Unverified,\n}\n\n/// Resource requirements for MCP server\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct ResourceRequirements {\n    /// Memory requirement in MB\n    pub memory_mb: u32,\n    /// CPU cores required\n    pub cpu_cores: f32,\n    /// Network access required\n    pub network_access: bool,\n    /// File system access level\n    pub filesystem_access: FilesystemAccess,\n}\n\n/// Filesystem access levels\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub enum FilesystemAccess {\n    /// No file system access\n    None,\n    /// Read-only access to user directories\n    ReadOnly,\n    /// Full read-write access\n    ReadWrite,\n}\n\n/// Agent registration info\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct AgentRegistration {\n    pub agent_id: String,\n    pub name: String,",
